title: 第二十五章 白草红叶黄花第二十六章 孤村杀机
content_zh:
夜风渐冷，村子中心几口大锅已经搬走了，就留下一些残余炭火在风中忽明忽暗。
周无纪站在门头阴影下方，默默打量着的村子中心这块地方。
村子里有不少人家养了狗，陌生人要是随意从各家院墙穿行，必定会引发狗吠。
正常来说，进入村子的人都要走这条路。
周无纪也是闲着没事，过来盯一会。
隔壁的房门轻响，穿着杏黄道袍的无明款步走过来，她才走了两步就看到站在门口的周无纪，心里微微一惊顿时止住脚步。
她轻声问道：“师兄、这么晚还不休息？”
“嗯，还不困，就出来看看。”
周无纪看了眼无明，这女人半夜三更不睡觉却来找他，是想以身相许报救命之恩？
他也知道这不太可能，只是无明着实漂亮。
幽幽夜色中，无明一双晶亮水润眸子那么勾人魂魄，夜风轻拂道袍勾勒出的婀娜身段更是动人。
“师兄救我性命，我无以为报，这里有一张七品北斗天罡神符，送给师兄护身。”
无明喝了一点米酒，吐气如兰中还带着一丝丝酒香。
周无纪六感敏锐，精准捕捉到的那旖旎香气的微妙成分，他感觉如饮醇酒，心里已经有了两分熏熏然。
他转即感觉不对，咱可是吃过见过的，可不能这样没出息。
他客气推辞道：“师妹太客气了，这如何使得。”
无明脸颊微红，把手里法符硬塞到周无纪手里，转身就跑了。
周无纪微微一笑对着无明背影拱手：“师妹一片盛情，却之不恭，多谢了……”
法符用上品符纸绘制，上面鲜红朱砂符文隐隐散发出赤红灵光。
周无纪认识上面符文，这是七品北极天罡神符。

激发神符可以转化出北极天罡，护持身心内外，不受邪魔外力侵蚀破坏。
北极天罡神符最高明之处在于转化元炁为罩，甚至可以抵挡七品武者全力数击。
如此神符需要法符大师绘制，还要请上部众神加持，一张法符至少要卖五十两黄金。
关键是有钱也很难买到。
无明能拿出如此贵重护身神符，家世应该也不错。
周无纪对于下院情况实在是不了解，也猜不出无明家世出身。
好在这不重要，他也不想吃软饭。倒是无明素手软滑，摸了一下还是挺舒服。
北极派不禁嫁娶，但是，道侣就只能选一个，绝不能乱来。
周无纪心里也清楚，他对无明就是见色起意，都是男人本能，和爱什么的毫无关系。
这种若近若远的关系，还挺有趣的。真要成了情侣，可能反而没意思。
周无纪琢磨了一会北极天罡神符，这才收入左手袖袋。
有了这张神符，遇到七品武者也能硬扛几招……
回到房间，这是村民让出来的房间，两间形制，砖木结构。
房梁很高，上铺青瓦。一间卧室，一间厨房带着一张方桌。
房间简陋，好在床上铺的是新席子，还有浆洗干净的薄被。
周无纪都没脱道袍，就是脱了十方鞋在床上一躺，七星剑放在身侧。
真要有事，立即就能取剑应变。
他默默运转北斗天枢经，炁转七十二周天，完成了今天的功课。
content_en:
The night wind was getting colder, and several large pots in the center of the village had been moved away, leaving only some residual charcoal fire flickering in the wind.
Zhou Wuji stood under the shadow of the door, silently looking at the center of the village.
Many families in the village have dogs. If strangers walk through the walls of various houses at will, the dogs will inevitably bark.
Normally, everyone entering the village must take this road.
Zhou Wuji also had nothing to do, so he came over to stare at it for a while.
There was a soft knock on the door of the next door, and Wu Ming, who was wearing an apricot Taoist robe, walked over. She only took two steps when she saw Zhou Wuji standing at the door. She was slightly startled and stopped in her tracks.
She asked softly: "Senior brother, why don't you rest so late?"
"Well, if you're not sleepy yet, just come out and take a look."
Zhou Wuji glanced at Wu Ming. This woman came to him despite staying awake in the middle of the night. Did she want to repay her life-saving favor with her body?
He also knew that this was unlikely, but ignorance was really beautiful.
In the dim night, Wu Ming's pair of crystal clear eyes are so captivating, and the graceful figure outlined by the night breeze blowing in the Taoist robe is even more moving.
"Senior brother saved my life, I have nothing to repay. Here is a seventh-grade Beidou Tiangang Talisman, given to senior brother for protection."
Wu Ming drank a little rice wine, and his breath was like orchid, with a hint of wine aroma.
Zhou Wuji's six senses were sharp and he accurately captured the subtle components of the charming aroma. He felt like drinking mellow wine, and his heart was already filled with smoke.
He immediately felt something was wrong. We have eaten and seen this before, so we can’t be so useless.
He politely declined: "Junior sister is too polite, how can this be done?"
Wuming's cheeks were slightly red, he forced the talisman into Zhou Wuji's hand, turned around and ran away.
Zhou Wuji smiled slightly and cupped his hands at Wu Ming's back: "Junior sister is very kind, but disrespectful. Thank you very much..."
The talisman is drawn on high-grade talisman paper, and the bright red cinnabar runes on it faintly emit a red aura.
Zhou Wuji recognized the rune above. It was the seventh-grade Arctic Tiangang divine rune.
Exciting the talisman can transform into the Arctic Tiangang, which protects the body and mind inside and outside, and is not corroded and destroyed by evil external forces.
The most brilliant thing about the Arctic Tiangang Talisman is that it transforms Yuan Qi into a shield, which can even withstand the full strength of a seventh-level warrior.
Such a talisman needs to be drawn by a talisman master and blessed by the gods above. A talisman costs at least fifty taels of gold.
The key is that it’s hard to buy even if you have money.
Wu Ming could come up with such a valuable protective amulet, so he must have a good family background.
Zhou Wuji really didn't understand the situation in the House of Commons, and he couldn't guess Wuming's family background.
Fortunately, it doesn't matter, and he doesn't want to eat soft rice. However, Wu Mingsu's hands were soft and smooth, and it felt quite comfortable after touching it.
The North Pole sect cannot help but marry, but Taoist couples can only choose one, and they must not mess around.
Zhou Wuji also knew in his heart that his lust for Wu Ming was just a man's instinct and had nothing to do with love.
This kind of close yet distant relationship is quite interesting. If they really become a couple, it might be boring.
Zhou Wuji thought about the Arctic Tiangang Talisman for a while, and then put it in his left hand pocket.
With this talisman, I can withstand a few attacks from a seventh-grade warrior...
Returning to the room, this is the room given by the villagers. It is two rooms in shape and has a brick and wood structure.
The beams are very high and covered with blue tiles. One bedroom, one kitchen with a square table.
The room is simple, but fortunately the bed is covered with new mats and a clean starched thin quilt.
Zhou Wuji didn't even take off his Taoist robe. He just took off his Shifang shoes and lay down on the bed with the Seven Star Sword beside him.
If something really happens, you can immediately draw your sword to deal with it.
He silently circulated the Beidou Tianshu Meridian for seventy-two rounds, completing today's homework.
